VIDEO SCRIPT: CHRISTIAN MARRIAGE AND FAMILY
Grade: Grade 7 · Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Christian Marriage and Family. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• discuss the biblical teachings on marriage and family

• identify values needed to maintain stability in families

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)

• Practise: explain ways the church promotes values among young people before marriage
• Practise: identify values needed to maintain stability in families

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
